seo.title: Aakash Eye Hospital | Advanced Eye Care Across 6 Gujarat Branches
seo.description: Aakash Eye Hospital provides advanced cataract, LASIK, retina, glaucoma and OPD eye care across six branches in Gujarat: Visnagar, Ahmedabad, Bharuch, Gota, Himmatnagar and Juhapura.

slides.headline: A cataract clouds the natural lens of the eye, turning sharp vision hazy and making night driving and reading harder.
slides.imageAlt: An ophthalmologist examining a patient at a slit lamp microscope
slides.quote: Cataract surgery is not something to postpone until vision is gone. Once the lens starts limiting daily activity, day-care phaco surgery restores clarity in a single sitting.
slides.quoteShort: Once the lens limits daily activity, day-care surgery restores clarity.

slides.headline: Short sight, long sight and astigmatism blur the image the eye forms, and glasses are only one of the ways to correct it.
slides.imageAlt: An optometrist checking a patient using a trial frame with test lenses
slides.quote: A careful refraction comes first. Only after we confirm corneal thickness and a stable prescription do we discuss LASIK as an option for a patient.
slides.quoteShort: A careful refraction comes first, and only then do we discuss LASIK.

slides.headline: Bladeless femtosecond laser replaces the manual blade in cataract and LASIK steps, adding precision where it matters most.
slides.imageAlt: Bladeless robotic laser surgery suite at Aakash Eye Hospital
slides.quote: The laser performs the incision and lens fragmentation to a planned depth. That consistency is what supports a smoother recovery for the patient.
slides.quoteShort: The laser cuts to a planned depth every time, which aids recovery.

slides.headline: Diabetes and ageing can damage the retina quietly, which is why imaging often finds a problem before a patient notices one.
slides.imageAlt: A retinal imaging device displaying a scan of a patient eye
slides.quote: Every patient with diabetes should have a dilated retina check each year. OCT and FFA let us see change early, while treatment still protects vision.
slides.quoteShort: Every patient with diabetes needs a dilated retina check each year.

slides.headline: Glaucoma damages the optic nerve, usually with raised eye pressure and usually without symptoms until side vision is already lost.
slides.imageAlt: A patient having eye pressure checked on a diagnostic machine with a clinician
slides.quote: Vision lost to glaucoma does not come back, so screening is the whole battle. A pressure check and a field test take minutes at any of our branches.
slides.quoteShort: Sight lost to glaucoma never returns, so screening is the whole battle.

slides.headline: Children rarely say their vision is blurred, so school-age eye checks catch squint, lazy eye and glasses needs while they are still treatable.
slides.imageAlt: A child covering one eye during a vision test at an eye clinic
slides.quote: Bring a child for a check before school starts, not after a teacher notices. Early correction is what protects a young eye from lasting weakness.
slides.quoteShort: Bring a child for a check before school starts, not after.

items.title: Founded at Visnagar
items.description: Aakash Eye Hospital started on 8 August 1993 in a town of nearly 100,000 people, with an initial 1,500 sq ft setup.

items.title: Phaco cataract surgery begins
items.description: The hospital became one of the pioneers in phaco cataract surgery in the region.

items.title: Excimer laser added
items.description: Excimer laser technology was introduced for glass removal and refractive procedures.

items.title: Retina diagnostics expanded
items.description: OCT, Green Laser and FFA capabilities were added for medical retina care.

items.title: Ahmedabad branch opens
items.description: The Odhav, Ahmedabad branch opened in a facility of approximately 5,500 sq ft.
